game.name: Chrome Hounds (Japan)
game.desc: Do giant, flashy robots make you drool all over the floor? Welcome to the world of Chrome Hounds. This action game for Xbox 360 puts you in command of gigantic mechas (called Hounds here) in six distinct campaigns in a dark futuristic conflict. Each campaign has a specific Hound. From the Sniper to the Defender and the assault model, enter a world of gleaming brutes!
